title: PHP & Laravel Developer
description: Craft modern, maintainable web applications, RESTful APIs, and scalable SaaS platforms using modern PHP 8.3+, Laravel 11, Eloquent ORM, and Livewire.

goal.objective: Deliver robust enterprise backends, rapid MVP web apps, and automated workflows leveraging the rich and battle-tested Laravel ecosystem.

learn.summary: Master PHP 8.3 features, Laravel 11 MVC patterns, Eloquent relationships, Blade templating, Livewire reactive components, queue workers, and Redis caching.

capstone_projects.title: Multi-Tenant SaaS Subscription Platform
capstone_projects.description: Build a multi-tenant business billing system with team workspaces, subscription webhook listeners, and automated invoicing.

capstone_projects.title: High-Volume Subscription Billing Platform with Laravel & Cashier
capstone_projects.description: Engineer an enterprise SaaS subscription system with team billing, metered usage calculations, queued webhook processing, and spatie permission controls.

interview_focus: Eloquent N+1 Query Problem & Eager Loading

tree.name: PHP & Web Foundations
tree.description: Establish a strong base in modern PHP programming, fundamental web concepts, and the MVC architectural pattern essential for Laravel development.

resources.title: Laravel PHP Framework Tutorial - Full Course for Beginners (freeCodeCamp)
PHP Full Course for Beginners (Bro Code)

children.name: Modern PHP Essentials
children.description: Master core PHP syntax, data types, control structures, functions, arrays, strings, date/time API (DateTimeImmutable), basic error handling with exceptions, and file system operations. Understand modern features like scalar and return type declarations, null coalescing, and arrow functions.

resources.title: Laravel Eloquent ORM Tutorial (The Net Ninja)

children.name: Object-Oriented PHP & Advanced Tooling
children.description: Dive into OOP principles (classes, objects, inheritance, polymorphism, interfaces, traits), visibility (public, protected, private), abstract classes, final keyword, static members, and basic magic methods. Master namespaces, Composer for dependency management, autoloading, PSR standards, and debugging with XDebug. Introduce static analysis tools like PHPStan/Psalm.

resources.title: Build a REST API with Laravel (Traversy Media)

children.name: Web Fundamentals & Security
children.description: Understand the HTTP protocol (methods, status codes, headers, stateless nature, REST principles), the request/response cycle, MVC pattern basics, forms, sessions, cookies, and critical web security concepts (XSS, CSRF, SQL injection prevention). Learn about input validation, sanitization, and server-side vs. client-side processing.

children.name: Version Control with Git
children.description: Master Git for version control, including branching, merging, pull requests, resolving conflicts, and collaborating on projects effectively using platforms like GitHub/GitLab. Understand essential Git commands and workflows.

resources.title: Laravel PHP Framework Tutorial - Full Course for Beginners (freeCodeCamp)
PHP Full Course for Beginners (Bro Code)

tree.name: Laravel Core Application Development
tree.description: Develop robust web applications using Laravel's core features, including routing, controllers, templating with Blade, and advanced database interactions with Eloquent.

resources.title: Laravel Eloquent ORM Tutorial (The Net Ninja)

children.name: Routing, Views & Request Validation
children.description: Implement routing definitions (resource, named, grouped), controller actions, comprehensive request validation using Form Request Objects, and effective use of middleware. Master the Blade templating engine, including components, slots, and efficient data passing to views, layout inheritance.

resources.title: Build a REST API with Laravel (Traversy Media)

children.name: Eloquent ORM, Migrations & Database
children.description: Manage databases with Migrations, Seeders, and factories. Interact with data using Eloquent ORM, defining relationships (one-to-one, one-to-many, many-to-many), query scopes, mutators/accessors, custom casts, and database transactions. Understand N+1 problem and eager loading. Utilize soft deletes and raw database queries (DB facade).

children.name: Authentication & Authorization
children.description: Implement robust user authentication with Laravel Breeze or Jetstream, manage user sessions, understand secure password hashing, and configure password reset functionality. Implement role-based authorization using Policies and Gates. Explore concepts like multi-auth (guards) and rate limiting for login attempts. Briefly touch upon Socialite for social login.

resources.title: Laravel PHP Framework Tutorial - Full Course for Beginners (freeCodeCamp)
PHP Full Course for Beginners (Bro Code)

children.name: RESTful API Development
children.description: Build RESTful APIs with JSON responses, utilize API resources for data transformation, handle API authentication with Laravel Sanctum, validate API requests, implement pagination, manage file uploads, and integrate with single-page applications (SPAs). Understand API versioning and rate limiting strategies. Explore Webhooks for real-time communication.

resources.title: Laravel Eloquent ORM Tutorial (The Net Ninja)

children.name: Project: User Management Module
children.description: Develop a complete user management module from scratch, including CRUD operations, role-based access control, robust validation, database migrations, and writing basic feature tests. This project reinforces core Laravel skills.

resources.title: Build a REST API with Laravel (Traversy Media)

tree.name: Advanced Laravel & Ecosystem
tree.description: Master advanced Laravel features like background processing, event-driven architecture, robust testing strategies, comprehensive caching, performance optimization techniques, and integrating with the broader Laravel ecosystem for production-ready applications.

children.name: Asynchronous Processing, Events & Notifications
children.description: Utilize Queues for asynchronous job processing, configure and manage workers, handle job retries, failed jobs, and job batching. Implement event-driven architecture with events and listeners, and explore event broadcasting with WebSockets (Laravel Echo/Pusher). Send various Notifications (mail, database, SMS) and schedule recurring tasks with the Task Scheduler.

resources.title: Laravel PHP Framework Tutorial - Full Course for Beginners (freeCodeCamp)
PHP Full Course for Beginners (Bro Code)

children.name: Comprehensive Testing & Debugging
children.description: Write comprehensive tests (Unit, Feature, Browser with Dusk). Effectively use database factories for test data, implement mocks and fakes. Understand Test-Driven Development (TDD) principles and Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) with tools like Pest PHP. Master debugging techniques with XDebug and utilize development tools like Laravel Debugbar. Integrate tests into Continuous Integration pipelines.

resources.title: Laravel Eloquent ORM Tutorial (The Net Ninja)

children.name: Caching & Performance Optimization Strategies
children.description: Implement various caching strategies (file, Redis, database, Memcached). Optimize database queries (e.g., N+1 problem, eager loading, database indexing). Profile application performance, identify common bottlenecks, and apply solutions like OPcache, CDN integration, and asset management with Vite/Laravel Mix.

resources.title: Build a REST API with Laravel (Traversy Media)

children.name: Production Security Best Practices
children.description: Deep dive into common web vulnerabilities and implement advanced prevention techniques (e.g., Content Security Policy, HSTS). Secure file uploads, manage environment variables safely, and follow best practices for securing Laravel applications. Understand secure dependency management (Composer audit). Briefly explore OAuth/OpenID Connect and vulnerability scanning concepts.

children.name: Laravel Ecosystem & Packages
children.description: Explore and integrate essential Laravel first-party packages (e.g., Nova for admin panels, Horizon for queue monitoring, Spark for SaaS starter kits) and popular community packages (e.g., Spatie packages for permissions, media library) to extend application functionality efficiently and adhere to common patterns.

resources.title: Laravel PHP Framework Tutorial - Full Course for Beginners (freeCodeCamp)
PHP Full Course for Beginners (Bro Code)

tree.name: Deployment, DevOps & Portfolio
tree.description: Learn to deploy Laravel applications professionally, incorporate DevOps principles for continuous integration and delivery, and build a compelling portfolio to showcase your skills.

resources.title: Laravel Eloquent ORM Tutorial (The Net Ninja)

children.name: CI/CD, Monitoring & Production Deployment
children.description: Configure production environments (Nginx, PHP-FPM, Supervisor). Understand server provisioning tools (Laravel Forge, Vapor). Automate deployments with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI). Implement robust logging (structured logging, ELK stack basics), error tracking (Sentry), and monitoring (Prometheus/Grafana basics, New Relic). Grasp concepts of horizontal scaling and load balancing.

resources.title: Build a REST API with Laravel (Traversy Media)

children.name: Containerization with Docker & Orchestration
children.description: Containerize Laravel applications using Docker, create optimized Dockerfiles (multi-stage builds), manage multi-service applications with Docker Compose (Nginx, PHP-FPM, MySQL, Redis). Understand Docker volumes, networks, and basic container orchestration concepts with Kubernetes or AWS ECS.

children.name: Project: Full-Stack E-commerce Platform
children.description: Build a comprehensive full-stack e-commerce application including product management, shopping cart, order processing, secure payment gateway integration, user authentication with multi-level roles, a robust admin panel, APIs for potential mobile integration, and deploy it to a production environment with CI/CD. Integrate modern frontend solutions like Livewire or Inertia.js.
